hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a final website hero bitmap, 1920x1080 or larger, exact 16:9. A wide cinematic view of a running software system at night. On the right 55 percent of the frame, a loose constellation of about twelve dark smoked-glass modules floats in layered depth: one larger central core module, and around it six distinct clusters of smaller modules, clearly separated from each other with space between them. Each cluster has a tiny mint status light. Hair-thin fibre-optic lines connect every cluster to the core, and a few small mint light pulses are caught mid-travel along the lines. A faint grid floor fades into haze below. The left 45 percent of the frame is calm, dark, nearly empty negative space with only soft haze, reserved for large headline typography. Lighting: the core glows softly from within, mint rim light on module edges, the rest in deep forest-black. Cinematic night-time render of a software system built as physical architecture. Dark graphite and smoked-glass modules, like minimal server units and service blocks, floating at different depths and connected by very thin fibre-optic lines. Data travels as small mint light pulses.
